steps.en: Point the CLI at the two commits the change lives between
steps.zh: 让 CLI 读改动所在的那两次提交

steps.en: Reads the diff and asks your model for one graph document
steps.zh: 读 diff，向你的模型要一份图文档

steps.en: Checks the document against the schema and returns errors to the model once
steps.zh: 按 schema 校验，报错退回模型改一次

steps.en: Render the document to SVGs on your own machine
steps.zh: 把图文档渲染成本地 SVG

steps.en: Draws a light and a dark SVG with the motion written into the markup
steps.zh: 输出明暗一对 SVG，动画写在标记里

steps.en: Attach the diagram to the pull request with gh pr create --attach
steps.zh: 用 gh pr create --attach 把图附到 PR 上

value.en: No scroll through two thousand changed lines to find where a change starts — the picture arrives with the pull request
value.zh: 不用先滚两千行 diff 找入口，改动的形状随 PR 一起到手
